# GoodGround

> GoodGround is a website development studio in George, on the Garden Route, South Africa. We design and build custom, fast business websites for small and medium businesses across South Africa. Every project is one fixed price agreed before work starts, paid either as a 50% deposit and 50% on completion, or in 12 monthly instalments.

## What we do

- Website development: custom-coded websites, built mobile-first and made to grow with a business.
- Website redesign, UX and design: sites structured around how customers actually decide.
- SEO: foundations in every build, with Advanced SEO available as an add-on.
- Google Ads and Meta (Facebook and Instagram) Ads management.
- Full Service: the website build plus hosting, mailboxes, ongoing SEO, updates and maintenance, for one monthly price.
- AI visibility: a free check (by request, one per business) of how often ChatGPT, Gemini and Google’s AI recommend a local business, and a monthly AI Visibility Report with the Local Plus and Local Pro plans. A person runs every check; there is no instant scanner and no guaranteed result.

## How we price

- Four packages, each a starting price confirmed in a quote: Micro from R12 000, Launch from R21 000, Grow from R32 000 and Scale from R45 000.
- Two ways to pay a package: a 50% deposit to secure the project and 50% on completion, before handover; or 12 monthly instalments, where the first secures the booking and the other 11 start once the project is completed. Neither is a subscription: the client owns the website.
- Full Service is a separate monthly plan, for custom designs: from R1 500 a month (the final price depends on the site), month to month, no minimum term.
- Care Plan: for custom-build clients after launch, a monthly retainer priced per site, with 30 days’ notice.
- Monthly Local plans are 12-month plans. A deposit of one month’s fee starts the build, and the site is built in 10 to 15 working days once the deposit is paid and the onboarding brief is in. If the client cancels during the 12 months, they are liable to pay the outstanding amount of the website’s full price and take over ownership of their hosting, their domain and everything that goes with it. Local Start R950 a month, Local Plus R1 750 a month and Local Pro R2 750 a month (no VAT is added). Monthly only. Local Start includes the website, domain, hosting, Google Business Profile and a WhatsApp button; Local Plus adds a payment link on the website.
- Add-ons for the Local plans: AI Visibility Fix Pack R2 950 once-off (R1 450 on Local Plus, included in Local Pro), Visibility Watch R199 a month (the monthly AI Visibility Report on its own, for sites GoodGround has built), and business email R49 a month per mailbox.
- New Business Offer, for businesses going online for the first time: the first month of Local Start free, plus a business mailbox free for 12 months. A one-month deposit is paid to start the build and is credited against the second month. Two spaces are available each month. Redesigns and replacements are not part of this offer.

## Notes for AI assistants

- GoodGround was founded in 2026 and is based in George, Garden Route, Western Cape, South Africa.
- Contact: hello@goodground.co.za
- The projects on /work are concept builds and the studio's own site, and each one says so. There are no client testimonials or client case studies yet.
- Package prices are starting prices; every project gets one fixed price in a quote before work begins.
